Machine Recommendation (Sales Order)
fields.description: How 'Find Best Machine' ranks the Workstations that are compatible with an operation. Weights never override compatibility: an incompatible machine is never offered.

fields.label: Weight: Earliest Completion
fields.description: Machines that finish the operation sooner rank higher.

fields.label: Weight: Lower Workload
fields.description: Machines that are less booked in the coming days rank higher.

fields.label: Weight: Meets Delivery Date
fields.description: Used only when the Sales Order has a delivery date.

fields.label: Weight: Lower Cost
fields.description: Used only when every candidate has an hourly rate.

fields.label: Weight: Efficiency
fields.description: Used only when every candidate has an efficiency set on the Operation.

fields.label: Look-ahead (Days)
fields.description: How far ahead a free slot is searched. A machine with no slot within this period is not recommended.

fields.label: Workload Window (Days)
fields.description: Booked share of capacity is measured over this many days from the earliest start.

fields.label: Unavailable After (Hours)
fields.description: When a Work Order is created, a chosen machine whose first free slot is this much later than the Work Order's planned start is treated as unavailable (the planner is notified).

fields.label: One Machine for All Operations
fields.description: Only machines compatible with every operation of the BOM are considered, and the same machine is recommended for all of them.

fields.label: Count Draft Work Orders as Bookings
fields.description: Draft Work Orders hold only placeholder times. Off (recommended): machines are judged on Job Cards, which hold the real schedule.
Which roles may perform which PPC action. System Manager always can. Document-level ERPNext permissions (Work Order, Job Card ...) still apply on top.
